findings.issue: אֵל is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper noun. Capitalized El leaves it untranslated and adds a title.
H8443 is a feminine plural construct noun of eminence or lofty projection. fuerzas closes it as abstract force.
רְאֵם is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper name. reem leaves the lemma untranslated.

notes: Hiphil participle plus 3mp, מִן plus Egipto, כְּ, construct plural, and ל plus 3ms are represented.
